# Same Old Samsara

> The creative outlet of Chad and Daniel: a documentary series about building a homestead on 34 acres in Central New York, handmade beaded jewelry (Etsy: sameoldsamsara), and brick stitch and bead loom beading patterns (Etsy: samsaradigitals). Motto: the same old cycle.

Headings on this site are lowercase on purpose. Prices are in USD.

## Films
- [Films](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/films/): A documentary about our first year out here. Episode 1 starts at the very beginning, when we first stepped onto the land. New episodes through the winter. Season 2 starts spring 2027.
- [YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@sameoldsamsara): Same Old Samsara, a season a year. Season 1 is 2026.
- [Season 1 · Episode 1: we bought land.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xSpspkCw9og) (41:24): 34 acres of goldenrod and woods in Central New York. How we found it, the rough perc test, and the first walk as owners.
- [Season 1 · Episode 2: our first month on 34 acres.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YDUcJU_dp78) (23:33): No tractor and no brush hog, just a scythe, a push mower and a lot of goldenrod. We cut a path to the old shed, move the RV onto the land and ride out the first thunderstorm.
- [Season 1 · Episode 3: peak fall. then the cold came.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SDIN5Jiadio) (25:51): Red maples, gold goldenrod, then frost and the first snow. Four RV tires changed on soft ground, two bear stories, one tree that had to come down, and a few 28 degree nights that made the call for us.
- [Season 1 · Episode 4: hunting for a lost well.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UhMJZrZttDI) (26:41): A neighbor says there's an old well somewhere on the land, so Chad builds a contraption out of a pipe and some wire and goes looking. We move the house site, find a giant sycamore leaf on an island in the river, and the trail cam catches its first raccoon.

## Make
- [Make](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/make/): everything we make in one place, beading patterns and recipes so far.

## Beading patterns
PDF patterns. Paid ones are instant downloads from [Samsara Digitals on Etsy](https://samsaradigitals.etsy.com). Full library: https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/

- [pumpkin](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/pumpkin/): free brick stitch pattern. A little round pumpkin with a curly stem. Quick, cute and free. PDF: https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/assets/pumpkin.pdf
- [rainbow diamonds](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/rainbow-diamonds/): free loom pattern. A rainbow diamond band for the bead loom. Free. PDF: https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/assets/rainbowdiamonds.pdf
- [christmas tree](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/christmas-tree/): free brick stitch pattern. A three tier pine with a gold star and a few lights. One piece worked up from the widest row, so it's a good first pattern. Free for the holidays. PDF: https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/assets/christmastree.pdf
- [flying saucer](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/flying-saucer/): brick stitch pattern, $2.99. A gray saucer beaming down. Yellow beam or rainbow beam, both in one PDF. Buy: https://www.etsy.com/listing/1777788647
- [jellyfish (3 sizes)](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/jellyfish/): brick stitch pattern, $4.99. A round jellyfish bell with wavy fringe. Small, medium and large, two colorways, all in one PDF. Buy: https://www.etsy.com/listing/4604569492
- [magic rainbow mushroom](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/magic-rainbow-mushroom/): brick stitch pattern, $2.99. A rainbow cap on a little beige stem. Bright and a little trippy. Buy: https://www.etsy.com/listing/1765666810
- [om symbol](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/om-symbol/): brick stitch pattern, $2.99. A black Om on a soft beige ground. Simple and steady. Buy: https://www.etsy.com/listing/4456770826
- [rainbow parrot](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/rainbow-parrot/): brick stitch pattern, $2.99. A scarlet macaw in nine colors: red, gold, green, cornflower and a long navy tail on a perch. Buy: https://www.etsy.com/listing/4456758738
- [silly goose](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/silly-goose/): brick stitch pattern, $2.99. A white goose with an orange beak and feet, framed in black. For the silly geese. Buy: https://www.etsy.com/listing/1784926935
- [squid (wavy fringe)](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/squid-wavy-fringe/): brick stitch pattern, $3.99. A little plum squid with big eyes and long wavy fringe tentacles. The wave comes from the thread, and the pattern shows you how. Buy: https://www.etsy.com/listing/4604548842
- [triceratops](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/triceratops/): brick stitch pattern, $2.99. A little green triceratops with terra cotta horns and a spotted back. Buy: https://www.etsy.com/listing/1778070364
- [aliens](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/aliens-loom/): loom pattern, $2.99. A row of little alien heads for the bead loom. Green or rainbow. Buy: https://www.etsy.com/listing/1760591136
- [dna double helix](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/dna-double-helix/): loom pattern, $2.99. A rainbow double helix bracelet for the bead loom. Buy: https://www.etsy.com/listing/1792298367
- [rainbow snake](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/rainbow-snake/): loom pattern, $2.99. A rainbow snake wave for the bead loom. Buy: https://www.etsy.com/listing/1774234169
- [rainbow spirals](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/rainbow-spirals/): loom pattern, $2.99. Rainbow spirals for the bead loom. Bold and hypnotic. Buy: https://www.etsy.com/listing/1775314125
- [jack o' lantern](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/jack-o-lantern/): brick stitch pattern, $2.99. A grinning jack o' lantern. Buy: https://www.etsy.com/listing/1788945937
- [jack o' lantern in a witch hat](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/jack-o-lantern-witch-hat/): brick stitch pattern, $2.99. A jack o' lantern wearing a witch hat. Both Halloween classics at once. Buy: https://www.etsy.com/listing/1781842810
- [spooky ghost](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/spooky-ghost/): brick stitch pattern, $2.99. A wavy little ghost mid float. Buy: https://www.etsy.com/listing/1792859785
- [spooky season](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/spooky-season/): brick stitch pattern, $2.99. A spooky season set for October. Buy: https://www.etsy.com/listing/1775414610
- [witch hat + wizard hat](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/witch-and-wizard-hats/): brick stitch pattern, $2.99. Two pointy hats, one listing. A witch hat and a starry wizard hat. Buy: https://www.etsy.com/listing/1781552260

## Tools
- [The field guide](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/land/#field-guide): the animals, plants and fungi found on the land so far, as a small guessing game.
- [The bead lab](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/bead-lab/): free in-browser brick stitch designer. Toho 11/0 colors, mirror mode, exports a word chart.

## Recipes
- [Maple Pecan Sweet Potato Mash](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/recipes/maple-pecan-sweet-potato-mash/): Creamy sweet potatoes baked under toasted pecans and a drizzle of maple syrup.
